propositions: A developer environment's plan-review attestation is rejected at the bugfix-size gate solely because the signing environment is not pinned in trusted_environments.yaml, regardless of whether a valid plan review was actually completed and signed.

No executable path exists for a contributor to obtain a prod-attested plan-review signature: the opcert service has no client in the repo, deliberately cannot persist signatures, and requires a production secret.

The not-pinned arm of classify_plan_review_attestation returns an affirmative 'mismatch' verdict that flows to BLOCK, making the criterion unsatisfiable for any developer-environment review until their environment is pinned.

The gate gates on the SOURCE of certification (who signed) rather than on the FACT of a completed, signed, subject-bound, lifecycle-valid attestation, conflicting with the documented design constraint.

Subject binding (ticket id + kind from the signed payload) must be re-asserted as an explicit step when removing cross-host source verification, since it was the only enforcement site in verify_opcert.
